role: Auditable bibliography for map and event dataset, with independent government/scholarly source distinction.

records.title: Neil Murphy (2019), The Tudor Occupation of Boulogne: Conquest, Colonisation and Imperial Monarchy, 1544–1550
records.finding: 1544 English conquest and settlement, forts and fiscal/border politics; until 1550
records.precision_warning: The monograph's paywalled full text and full historic map not inspected.

records.title: Murphy, Chapter 3, Conquest, Cartography and Treaty
records.finding: Land conquest/1546 peace and mapmaking to justify 1544–50 Boulogne annexation. Linear boundary maps historic but not accessed.
records.precision_warning: No source supports drawing exact Boulogne region boundary from abstract alone.

records.title: Murphy, Chapter 4, The Settlement of the Boulonnais
records.finding: English commissions redistributed farms, changed laws and religion, administered French peasant workforce.
records.precision_warning: Dates of each farm/occupied parish and precise geography not read; never count approximate polygon as measured estate.

records.title: Murphy, Chapter 5, The Boulogne Garrison
records.finding: English garrisons and fortified settlement, state fiscal burden.
records.precision_warning: Abstract does not contain detailed expenditure series or site-specific dates.

records.title: Murphy, Chapter 6, Tudor Occupation of Boulogne and English Imperialism
records.finding: Compares northern French military colonial settlement with English Ireland and Scottish warfare.
records.precision_warning: Cannot infer every geography/control point described in whole chapter.

records.title: The Battle of Pinkie, Mary Queen of Scots and the Anglo-Scottish Wars of the 1540s
records.finding: Documents 1547 Pinkie, English occupation of Broughty and Inchcolm, Scotland-France alliance and English fort attempts.
records.precision_warning: Contemporary 16c fortification survey maps not digitized.

records.title: The Story of Scotland's Longest Siege
records.finding: English occupation/Haddington fort in 1548 and prolonged Franco-Scottish siege through withdrawal 1549.
records.precision_warning: City historic military walls not georeferenced here.

records.title: Broughty Castle history and stories
records.finding: English captured Broughty Castle 1547 and maintained for two-and-half years, Scottish/French retook 1550.
records.precision_warning: Modern castle monument incorporates major 1860s rebuild; never draw visible present walls as 1547 perimeter.

records.title: Tudor Warships Ahoy! Inchcolm English garrison
records.finding: English force used Inchcolm 1547; withdrew in March 1548 due naval pressure; French then took Inchkeith, not Inchcolm.
records.precision_warning: Distinguish island abbey castle geography vs naval area; precise arrival month uncertain.

records.title: Lauder fortified English outpost 1548–1550
records.finding: English strong fort at Lauder protected Haddington supply road 1548, still English at peace in 1550.
records.precision_warning: Original fort site plotted roughly at NT 53 47 and not located to true wall perimeter; use town icon and dashed site uncertainty.

records.title: Battle of Pinkie Cleugh (BTL15)
records.institution: Historic Environment Scotland official battlefield register
records.finding: 1547 defeat of Scottish army but Scots kingdom remained independent; battle location is an event not conquest of country.
records.precision_warning: Battlefield modern protected designation should not be an English province polygon.

records.title: Broughty Castle location and NRHE
records.finding: Castle location 56.46293,-2.87022 (modern center).
records.precision_warning: Modern site geocoding not Tudor footprint.

records.title: St Mary's Parish Church Haddington, NRHE 56502
records.finding: Historic Haddington St Mary's church site 55.95332,-2.77198.
records.precision_warning: Historic town/tower anchor, not actual 1548 occupied fort wall.

records.title: Inchcolm Abbey location
records.institution: University of Virginia Scottish Court of Session Archive
records.finding: Island abbey point 56.03001,-3.30171.
records.precision_warning: Abbey point not island coastline or garrison footprint.

records.title: Château musée de Boulogne-sur-Mer site location
records.finding: Old upper town castle geographical reference 50.7256,1.6169.
records.precision_warning: Museum/restored walls not 1544 measured perimeter; source not primary historical cartography.

records.title: Boulogne and English Pale historical charts Cotton Augustus I ii 75, 77
records.institution: British Library manuscripts via scholarly discussion
records.finding: Ref to historic maps of country between Calais and Boulogne in Cotton Augustus I vol II nos 75 and 77.
records.precision_warning: Historical maps original images not consulted and not licensed to reproduce; check BL dating of each manuscript.

records.title: The reduction of Leinster and origins of Tudor conquest of Ireland c.1534–46
records.institution: Irish Historical Studies, Cambridge University Press
records.finding: Policy papers of 1537 and 1541 focused on Carlow/Wicklow and Dublin marches, early surrender-and-regrant strategy.
records.precision_warning: Title and subordinate allegiance not direct countrywide map control; full paper not read.

records.title: Creation of earls of Thomond/Clanricarde and Lord Ibrackan, July 1543
records.institution: National Library of Ireland manuscript catalogue
records.finding: Harleian MS 6074 excerpts in NLI microfilm; honours dated July 1543.
records.precision_warning: Peerage patents do not prove local full county land transfers; original patent not read.

records.title: Lambeth Ms 608 creation of Thomond/Clanricarde 1543/44
records.institution: National Library of Ireland manuscript catalogue
records.finding: Lambeth Palace Library Ms 608 original extract, NLI microfilm n2797.
records.precision_warning: Confirm 1543 and 1544 regnal dating from images; cannot treat all territory as regranted estate.

records.title: Crown of Ireland Act (Ireland), designated 1542 c. 1
records.institution: UK Legislation reference in Crime and Disorder Act 1998
records.finding: Modern British legislation explicitly cites 1542 c.1 Crown of Ireland Act; commonly described as 1541 Dublin Parliament act.
records.precision_warning: 1541 parliamentary passage versus official act short-title 1542 must be recorded separately. It changed royal style/claim, not effective control of Gaelic Ireland.

records.title: Tax grant 1545, military benevolence to finance Boulogne
records.institution: The National Archives E179 document notes
records.finding: Jan 1545 commissioners to raise military funds. Source quotes secondary estimate receipts £119,581 and identifies enrolled account E370/2/23, county returns E179.
records.precision_warning: £119,581 is historian's estimated realized collection, NOT Boulogne profit and not direct cost. Needs original roll for exact totals.

records.title: 1546 free and voluntary contribution for defending Boulogne/Calais
records.institution: The National Archives E179 document notes
records.finding: 16 May 1546 commissioners collected further grants to finance war in French enclaves.
records.precision_warning: No verified received total extracted; not colonial net gain.

records.title: Edward VI answers Western rebels: war expenses in Boulogne and Scotland
records.finding: 1549 royal reply explicitly admits Boulogne and Scottish garrison military costs and quotes inherited debt above £300,000.
records.precision_warning: Rhetorical royal text is a contemporary claim, not audited contemporary exchequer total; recorded debt is not profit.

records.title: Haddington siege heritage account: Hailes Castle and Forthill English fort
records.finding: English seized Hailes Castle March 1548, handed to Hugh Douglas, garrisoned by fifty English troops during Haddington siege; Tudor castle fort at nearby Forthill after 1547 Broughty seizure.
records.precision_warning: Hailes garrison end date must be researched; lordly local grant not territorial annexation of entire East Lothian.

records.title: Mont Lambert modern hamlet near Boulogne-sur-Mer
records.finding: Modern hamlet reference 50.71777 1.65893; distinct from historically precise 1546 Boulemberg fort.
records.precision_warning: Do not assert modern site equals sixteenth-century artillery fortress center without independent survey.

records.title: Ambleteuse modern Vauban Fort Mahon position
records.finding: Modern fort GPS 50.8054 1.60053, built in late 17th century; useful general Ambleteuse vicinity ONLY.
records.precision_warning: Prohibited to call this 1540s English fortification. Modern Vauban walls cannot be traced into 1544 boundaries.

records.title: Boulogne old upper walled town modern point
records.finding: Boulogne Vieille Ville point 50.724856,1.613445.
records.precision_warning: No evidence here of surveyed English occupation legal frontier.

records.title: English fort at Lauder, 1548-1550, archaeological notes
records.finding: Fort near grid NT 53 47 protected road for English Haddington 1548, English until 1550 peace.
records.precision_warning: Grid roughly 1km; no wall polygon or exact bastion site confirmed.

records.title: Irish Crown reform 1541 / historical act 1542 crosscheck
records.institution: British legislation official historical statute crossreference
records.finding: Official citation is Crown of Ireland Act 1542 c.1; 1541 Dublin Parliamentary enactment usually described, keep exact regnal legal title/date distinct.
records.precision_warning: Original Irish parliament act/roll not read. Legal kingly title does not prove island-wide actual rule.

records.title: 1545 Boulogne military finance benevolence enrolled account E370/2/23
records.finding: Aggregate £119,581 estimated receipts for 1545 war levy, described by TNA citing scholarship and E370/2/23.
records.precision_warning: This is estimated tax extraction within England to fund war, not measured French colonial revenue.

records.title: Haddington St Mary's Church modern site coordinate
records.finding: 55.95332 N -2.77198 W reference marker.
records.precision_warning: Church marker represents occupied Haddington town center not exact bastion trace.
